        self._spy_close = None
        self._spy_previous_close = None
        self._spy_previous_sma = None

        self._aapl_close = None
        self._aapl_red_streak = 0

        self._strategy_a_lot = 0
        self._strategy_b_lot = 0

        has_aapl = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self._aapl)

        if has_spy:
            self._update_spy_state(data.Bars[self._spy])

        if has_aapl:
            self._update_aapl_state(data.Bars[self._aapl])

        has_all_bars = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self._symbols)
        if self.IsWarmingUp or not has_all_bars or not self._rules_ready():

        spy_sma = self._spy_sma.Current.Value
        aapl_close = self._aapl_close
        aapl_rsi = self._aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        strategy_a_buy = (
            self._spy_previous_close <= self._spy_previous_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )
        strategy_a_sell = (
            self._spy_previous_close >= self._spy_previous_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        strategy_b_buy = self._aapl_red_streak >= 3
        strategy_b_sell = aapl_rsi > 60

        # Sell pass
        if self._strategy_a_lot > 0 and strategy_a_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self._spy, -self._strategy_a_lot)
            self._strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self._strategy_b_lot > 0 and strategy_b_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self._aapl, -self._strategy_b_lot)
            self._strategy_b_lot = 0

        # Buy pass
        if self._strategy_a_lot == 0 and strategy_a_buy:
            quantity = int(float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(spy_close))

                self.MarketOrder(self._spy, quantity)
                self._strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self._strategy_b_lot == 0 and strategy_b_buy:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / float(aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self._aapl, quantity)
                    self._strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self._spy_previous_close = self._spy_close
        self._spy_previous_sma = (
            self._spy_sma.Current.Value if self._spy_sma.IsReady else None
        )

        self._spy_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self._spy_close = bar.Close

            self._aapl_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self._aapl_red_streak = 0

        self._aapl_rsi.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self._aapl_close = bar.Close

    def _rules_ready(self):
        return (
            self._spy_sma.IsReady
            and self._aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self._spy_close is not None
            and self._spy_previous_close is not None
            and self._spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self._aapl_close is not None
        )
